title: 50 storey residential tower, Brisbane CBD: excavation
workplace: 50 storey residential tower with foyer and 3 level basement carpark, Brisbane CBD
note: Facts are example inputs for testing. On a real project they come from the contractor's own procedures and the project's documents.

swms.title: Bulk excavation of the basement
swms.task: Bulk excavate the 3 level basement inside the piled retention wall with excavators, loading trucks on the haul ramp, next to the neighbouring buildings and the street.

facts.excavationPlan: Excavation follows the geotechnical design GT-01 (revision C) in stages to the levels shown, with batters no steeper than 1 to 1, and plant and trucks follow the site traffic management plan TMP-02.
facts.fallControl: Edge protection is installed along the basement edge before excavation goes below 2 m, and access is by a scaffold stair.

steps: Protect the basement edge and provide access
Protect neighbouring buildings and the street

swms.title: Staged excavation, ground anchors and props
swms.task: Bulk excavate with excavators in stages in front of the retention wall, installing and stressing ground anchors and temporary props at each stage, and later de-stressing the anchors and removing the props.

facts.excavationPlan: Excavation follows the geotechnical design GT-01 (revision C) in stages to the levels shown, with batters no steeper than 1 to 1, and plant and trucks follow the site traffic management plan TMP-02.
facts.fallControl: Edge protection is installed along the basement edge before excavation goes below 2 m, and access is by a scaffold stair.
facts.temporarySupport: Ground anchors and props are to the geotechnical engineer's design GT-04 (revision B), with each stage approved by the engineer before excavation continues.

steps: Install, stress and later remove ground anchors and props
Protect the basement edge and provide access

swms.title: Detailed excavation for pile caps and lift pits
swms.task: Detailed excavation for the pile caps and lift pits up to 2.5 m deep in the basement with a 5 tonne excavator.

facts.trenchSupport: Pile caps and lift pits 1.5 m deep or more are battered, or shored to the engineer's design, or protected by a trench shield to the supplier's engineer's design.
facts.fallControl: Mesh barriers go up 1.5 m back around each pile cap and lift pit as it is dug, before it is deeper than 2 m.

steps: Excavate pile caps, lift pits and trenches

swms.title: Dewatering and contaminated spoil
swms.task: Bulk excavate the basement with excavators below the groundwater level with dewatering pumps, and handle spoil that may contain contaminated fill or acid sulfate soil.

facts.excavationPlan: Excavation follows the geotechnical design GT-01 (revision C) in stages to the levels shown, with batters no steeper than 1 to 1, and plant and trucks follow the site traffic management plan TMP-02.
facts.fallControl: Edge protection is installed along the basement edge before excavation goes below 2 m, and access is by a scaffold stair.

steps: Handle contaminated or unknown material in the spoil
Protect the basement edge and provide access

rules.phrase: traffic management plan is in place before plant starts
rules.quote: Traffic management arrangements must be implemented

rules.phrase: No one works ahead of the support
rules.quote: They should not work ahead of the shoring protection

rules.phrase: 1.5 m deep or more is supported
rules.source: Work Health and Safety Regulation 2011 (Qld) s 306
rules.quote: all sides of the trench are adequately supported

rules.phrase: No digging until steps are taken to prevent collapse of neighbouring buildings
